checks.description: Copy is plain, confident, and empowering. It speaks to what the reader can become and is never deficit-framed, shaming, or hype-driven.
checks.rule: Flag any span that frames the reader as lacking, behind, or failing, or that leans on hype words. Pass only when the framing is empowering and confident.

checks.description: No em dash glyph anywhere in the English copy.
checks.rule: Scan for the em dash glyph (U+2014). Any occurrence is a fail; the fix replaces it with a comma, colon, or period.

checks.description: All digits are Western numerals 0 to 9, never Eastern Arabic numerals.
checks.rule: Scan for Eastern Arabic-Indic digits (U+0660 to U+0669). Any occurrence is a fail; the fix substitutes the Western numeral.

checks.description: Where a call to action applies, there is exactly one clear primary CTA, not zero and not competing CTAs.
checks.rule: If the asset type calls for action, fail when there is no clear CTA or when two or more CTAs compete. Mark not-applicable for copy with no intended action.

checks.description: Copy never states or implies that certificates are accredited.
checks.rule: Flag any wording that says or implies accreditation. Completion certificates are not accredited; any such claim is a fail.

checks.description: No Skill Path title, content lineup item, instructor name, price, or offer appears unless confirmed in the brief or context.
checks.rule: Cross-check every named offer, title, instructor, and price against the brief and context. Any unconfirmed specific is a fail, not a guess.

checks.description: Short sentences, concrete nouns, active voice; no stiff, corporate, or over-explained phrasing.
checks.rule: Flag passive, corporate, or over-explained spans that break the plain, confident tone benchmark.

checks.description: The gate returns a binary verdict with a structured fix list on fail.
checks.rule: Result is pass only when every applicable check passes; otherwise fail with one fix item per failing check, each item naming the check, the quoted span, and the required change.
